title: Demonic Portal Guardian
description: A blue horned demon with glowing eyes stands beside a black armored figure with a featureless helmet. They emerge from a massive ancient stone archway carved with runes, set against a cosmic nebula sky with a sprawling fantasy city in the background.
prompt: A towering muscular blue demon with large curved horns and glowing white eyes stands next to a sleek black armored warrior with a completely featureless helmet. They stand beneath a giant ancient stone archway covered in runes, with a sprawling mystical city and glowing water behind them. A massive gnarled tree grows over the arch. The background is a vibrant cosmic nebula with purple, pink and teal clouds and stars, in a dramatic cinematic fantasy style.
